title: Calendar displays events twice on multi-screen setup
line: Opening a second Digital Clock while another one is open no longer lists every calendar event twice.
explanation: Calendar event plugins are loaded once per process and their signals are relayed to every calendar's DaysModel. When a second clock popup loads its month, the plugin emits its data again and every open calendar appends it, so events and dots are duplicated once per clock opened. DaysModel::onDataReady now skips events that are already in the model for that day (same uid, title, type, start and end).

commits.message:
components/calendar: Don't add events the model already has

Event plugins are shared by every calendar, so opening a second clock
while another one stays open made it receive the same events again and
list them twice. Events that are already present are now skipped.

BUG: 445979

media.caption: Clock 1 alone: today's name day listed once
After pinning clock 1 and opening clock 2: listed three times, three dots per day
After pinning clock 1 and opening and closing clock 2: still listed once, one dot per day
